briefing: Markets were flat to slightly negative today (NASDAQ -0.4%, S&P 500 -0.2%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) sits below the $500 deployment threshold, so per prior lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy into a neutral session — waiting for a genuine risk-on setup or more cash to accumulate before filling the remaining 3 open slots.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors pull back from adding new positions because market signals aren't strong enough to justify the risk — even if nothing bad has happened, the absence of a clear positive catalyst is reason enough to wait. Today's flat, directionless market combined with limited cash below the deployment threshold made patience the better choice than forcing a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」（Risk-Off）指投資者在市場訊號不夠強烈、不足以支持額外風險時，選擇暫緩新增持倉——即使沒有壞消息出現，缺乏明確的正面催化劑本身已是觀望的理由。今日大市走勢平淡、方向不明，加上可動用現金低於部署門檻，因此耐心等待比勉強交易更為明智。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today in quiet, directionless trading, with the NASDAQ off 0.4% and the S&P 500 down 0.2%. There was no single dominant catalyst driving the move — it reflects a market pausing to digest recent gains rather than reacting to a specific shock. Volume and volatility both stayed subdued, consistent with a wait-and-see posture ahead of upcoming data.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市窄幅波動，NASDAQ指數下跌0.4%，標普500指數下跌0.2%，走勢並無明顯方向。市場並非受單一重大消息影響，而更似是消化早前升幅後的短暫喘息。成交量及波動性均維持在較低水平，反映投資者在重要數據公布前採取觀望態度。
